s002: The nurse leans closer and slowly adjusts the cat's breathing tube; the cat's chest rises and falls gently, monitor lights blink behind. Camera: subtle handheld drift, slow push-in.
s003: Lines scroll steadily across the monitors and the numbers flicker; the oxygen dome sways very slightly. Camera: slow handheld drift to the right.
s004: The gloved hands tuck the towel and steady the cat's head with slow, careful motions; the X-ray arm stays still. Camera: slow handheld push-in.
s006: The hand holds the tub perfectly steady with no turning; the tub stays perfectly still with its label readable, only soft daylight shifting on the wall. Camera: very slow handheld push-in.
s008: The hand tips the scoop and the powder falls onto the food as the cat leans in, sniffing eagerly, whiskers twitching. Camera: steady handheld, slight push-in.
s009: The cat eats eagerly, head bobbing as it chews, ears twitching; the tub stays perfectly still with its label readable. Camera: subtle handheld drift.
s011: The cat licks the bowl clean with quick tongue strokes, nudging it slightly across the floor, tail swaying. Camera: gentle handheld drift, slow push-in.
